_comment: Demo topics for the Deep Research Agent, chosen so a reviewer can see the
pipeline behave differently rather than four variations of the same run.
Each names the internal document that gives the run something to disagree
with - the 'Where Sources Disagree' section is the whole reason the
internal and external halves are researched independently, and it only
has material to work with when the firm has a prior view on the topic.
Run one with: uv run kickoff "<topic>"

topics.why: The strongest demo. The firm passed on two SMR developers eighteen months ago on regulatory-timeline risk, and external evidence has since moved - binding NRC licensing deadlines, gigawatt-scale data centre offtake. The report should tell the committee its own prior reasoning has been overtaken.
The firm ran full diligence and passed for reasons unrelated to the technology. Tests whether the analysis surfaces why it passed rather than re-deriving a view from scratch.

The firm's internal view is 'pre-commercial, too early'. External funding evidence contradicts it. Also the thinnest external coverage of the four, so it exercises the instruction to report a sparse result honestly instead of padding.
The firm's technical advisor rated these years behind light-water SMRs. Useful as a contrast to the SMR run: the same sector scan, a different verdict.

Deliberately out-of-scope for the mock knowledge base - the only internal document mentioning it is the prior report used as a style reference, which is not retrievable evidence. Use this to check the internal researcher reports 'no prior internal work' instead of inventing a firm view.
